projects.summary_en: Layer compositing and photo editing for Apple silicon Macs, with Photoshop-style workflows.
projects.summary_zh: 面向 Apple silicon Mac 的图层合成与照片编辑器，采用 Photoshop 式工作流。
projects.requirements_en: Apple silicon Mac with macOS 26+; source builds need Xcode 26+, and PSD/PSB import is limited to 8-bit RGB.
projects.requirements_zh: 需要 Apple silicon Mac 和 macOS 26+；源码构建需 Xcode 26+，PSD/PSB 导入仅支持 8-bit RGB。

projects.summary_en: An alpha image editor reimplementing Photoshop-style workflows in Rust.
projects.summary_zh: 用 Rust 重新实现 Photoshop 式工作流的图像编辑器，目前处于 alpha 阶段。
projects.requirements_en: Alpha downloads are available; check your PSD files and workflow because format interchange and plug-in support remain incomplete.
projects.requirements_zh: 已有 alpha 下载版；PSD 互操作和插件支持尚不完整，使用前先检查自己的文件和工作流。

projects.summary_en: Browser-based vector design with layers and editable node graphs.
projects.summary_zh: 在浏览器中结合图层和节点图进行矢量设计。
projects.requirements_en: Open the browser editor; it is still alpha, with broader creative workflows under development.
projects.requirements_zh: 可直接打开浏览器编辑器；目前仍是 alpha，更多创作工作流还在开发中。

projects.summary_en: A 2D animation and motion-graphics editor with vector tools, timelines and expressions.
projects.summary_zh: 提供矢量工具、时间线和表达式的二维动画与动态图形编辑器。
projects.requirements_en: Desktop downloads are available; After Effects project and plug-in compatibility is not promised, and custom shaders are experimental.
projects.requirements_zh: 可下载桌面版；不保证兼容 After Effects 项目和插件，自定义 shader 仍属实验功能。

projects.summary_en: A CapCut-style browser video editor whose next version is being rewritten.
projects.summary_zh: 采用 CapCut 式剪辑工作流的浏览器视频编辑器，下一版正在重写。
projects.requirements_en: The live site runs the classic early beta; desktop, mobile and automation plans are not established stable features.
projects.requirements_zh: 官网当前运行的是 classic 早期 beta；桌面端、移动端和自动化等规划尚不能当作稳定功能。

projects.summary_en: A collaborative interface-design and prototyping tool with hosted and self-hosted options.
projects.summary_zh: 提供托管和自托管两种方式的协作界面设计与原型工具。
projects.requirements_en: Use a hosted account or set up your own server; migrating designs requires export and import.
projects.requirements_zh: 注册托管服务账号或自行部署服务器；迁移已有设计需要导出和导入。

projects.summary_en: A desktop suite for offline documents, spreadsheets, presentations and PDF editing.
projects.summary_zh: 将离线文档、电子表格、演示文稿和 PDF 编辑整合在一起的桌面办公套件。
projects.requirements_en: Local editing needs no Microsoft Office account; check complex layouts and macros, and use a compatible service for cloud collaboration.
projects.requirements_zh: 本地编辑无需 Microsoft Office 账号；请先检查复杂排版和宏，云协作需另接兼容服务。

projects.summary_en: A desktop office suite with Writer, Calc and Impress for everyday documents.
projects.summary_zh: 包含 Writer、Calc 和 Impress 的桌面办公套件，可处理日常文档、表格和演示文稿。
projects.requirements_en: Install the desktop version without an Office subscription; test VBA macros and complex Office templates before switching.
projects.requirements_zh: 安装桌面版即可使用，无需 Office 订阅；迁移前请测试 VBA 宏和复杂 Office 模板。

projects.summary_en: Spreadsheet-style editing backed by relational data, for structured tables and linked records.
projects.summary_zh: 将电子表格式编辑与关系数据结合，用于整理表格和关联记录。
projects.requirements_en: Use the local desktop app, self-host the Community edition or choose a hosted account with plan limits.
projects.requirements_zh: 可使用本地桌面版、自托管 Community 版，或选择有套餐限制的托管服务。

projects.summary_en: Winamp 2-style audio playback and skins recreated in a browser.
projects.summary_zh: 在浏览器中重现 Winamp 2 的播放器界面和换肤体验。
projects.requirements_en: Open the browser player and bring your own audio; no Winamp installation is needed.
projects.requirements_zh: 打开浏览器播放器并导入自己的音频即可，无需安装 Winamp。

projects.summary_en: A browser recreation of the Windows XP desktop, Start menu and small built-in apps.
projects.summary_zh: 在浏览器中重现 Windows XP 桌面、开始菜单和部分小应用。
projects.requirements_en: No XP installation files are needed; the demo cannot run arbitrary Windows software.
projects.requirements_zh: 无需 XP 安装文件；这个演示不能运行任意 Windows 软件。

projects.summary_en: An alpha vector editor reworking Illustrator-style pen, path and appearance workflows.
projects.summary_zh: 重新实现 Illustrator 式钢笔、路径和外观工作流的矢量编辑器，目前处于 alpha 阶段。
projects.requirements_en: Desktop installers are available; test complex file interchange and appearance effects before moving a project.
projects.requirements_zh: 已有桌面安装包；迁移项目前请先检查复杂文件的导入导出和外观效果。

projects.summary_en: An alpha photo-library and RAW-development tool with nondestructive color adjustment.
projects.summary_zh: 提供照片管理、RAW 显影和非破坏式调色的工具，目前处于 alpha 阶段。
projects.requirements_en: Desktop installers are available; camera calibration and some compressed RAW formats remain incomplete.
projects.requirements_zh: 已有桌面安装包；相机色彩校准和部分压缩 RAW 格式仍有缺口。

projects.summary_en: An early 2D drafting tool with commands, object snaps, layers and dimensions.
projects.summary_zh: 提供命令行、对象捕捉、图层和尺寸标注的二维制图工具，仍在早期开发中。
projects.requirements_en: Desktop installers are available; check DWG compatibility and do not assume AutoCAD 3D or industry plug-in support.
projects.requirements_zh: 已有桌面安装包；请检查 DWG 兼容性，不能据此假定支持 AutoCAD 的三维功能和行业插件。

projects.summary_en: A pre-alpha audio workstation with recording, track editing, mixing and MIDI arrangement.
projects.summary_zh: 提供录音、音轨编辑、混音和 MIDI 编排的音频工作站，目前处于 pre-alpha 阶段。
projects.requirements_en: Desktop installers are available; audio-device/buffer selection, MIDI-controller recording and AAF/OMF interchange are still missing.
projects.requirements_zh: 已有桌面安装包；音频设备与缓冲区选择、MIDI 控制器录制及 AAF/OMF 互操作尚未完成。

projects.summary_en: An alpha video editor with source/program monitors, multitrack timelines and trim editing.
projects.summary_zh: 提供源素材与节目监视器、多轨时间线和修剪功能的视频编辑器，目前处于 alpha 阶段。
projects.requirements_en: Desktop installers are available; large-media handling, effect rendering and professional project interchange remain incomplete.
projects.requirements_zh: 已有桌面安装包；大型素材处理、效果渲染和专业项目互操作仍有缺口。

projects.summary_en: An early-alpha PDF tool for reading, annotations, page organization, merging and splitting.
projects.summary_zh: 提供阅读、批注、页面整理、合并和拆分的 PDF 工具，目前处于早期 alpha 阶段。
projects.requirements_en: Desktop installers are available; full Acrobat editing, signature and prepress workflows are not covered.
projects.requirements_zh: 已有桌面安装包；尚未覆盖 Acrobat 的完整编辑、签名和印前工作流。

projects.summary_en: Transport Tycoon-style transport-company simulation with expanded multiplayer.
projects.summary_zh: 延续 Transport Tycoon 玩法的运输公司经营游戏，并扩展了多人功能。
projects.requirements_en: Use the required free OpenGFX2 or OpenGFX graphics; OpenSFX sound and OpenMSX music are optional, with no original game files needed for this route.
projects.requirements_zh: 使用免费的 OpenGFX2 或 OpenGFX 基础画面即可，无需原版文件；OpenSFX 音效和 OpenMSX 音乐可选。

projects.summary_en: A RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 reimplementation with improvements such as cooperative multiplayer.
projects.summary_zh: 重新实现 RollerCoaster Tycoon 2，并加入合作多人等改进。
projects.requirements_en: Supply your own RCT2 data files; RCT1 data can add its scenarios.
projects.requirements_zh: 需要自备 RCT2 数据文件；另有 RCT1 数据时可添加其场景。

projects.summary_en: A Morrowind engine replacement with modern compatibility and graphics options.
projects.summary_zh: 为 Morrowind 提供现代系统兼容性和图形选项的替代引擎。
projects.requirements_en: Own Morrowind and configure its data files; check support for your existing mods.
projects.requirements_zh: 需要持有 Morrowind 并配置其数据文件；已有模组需单独检查兼容性。

projects.summary_en: A modernized take on classic RTS games, including the original Red Alert rather than Red Alert 2.
projects.summary_zh: 以现代操作方式重新演绎经典即时战略游戏，包含初代 Red Alert，而非 Red Alert 2。
projects.requirements_en: First-run setup can fetch required original assets or import them from original discs; rules and balance differ from the originals.
projects.requirements_zh: 首次启动可按引导获取所需原版素材，或从原版光盘导入；规则和平衡性与原作存在差异。

projects.summary_en: A Heroes of Might and Magic II engine recreation with modern interface improvements.
projects.summary_zh: 重新实现 Heroes of Might and Magic II 引擎，并改进现代设备上的操作界面。
projects.requirements_en: Supply full original-game data or use the documented official English demo route for limited content.
projects.requirements_zh: 自备完整原版数据，或按文档使用官方英文试玩版体验有限内容。

projects.summary_en: A reimplementation of the two classic X-COM games with mod support.
projects.summary_zh: 重新实现两款经典 X-COM 游戏，并支持扩展模组。
projects.requirements_en: Provide unmodified UFO: Enemy Unknown or Terror from the Deep data; the Windows installer can import an owned Steam copy.
projects.requirements_zh: 需要未经修改的 UFO: Enemy Unknown 或 Terror from the Deep 数据；Windows 安装器可导入自有 Steam 版本。

projects.summary_en: A Heroes III engine replacement with mods, multiplayer and desktop/mobile versions.
projects.summary_zh: 支持模组、多人及桌面与移动设备的 Heroes III 替代引擎。
projects.requirements_en: Full play needs Heroes III Complete or Shadow of Death data; HD Edition alone is insufficient, and iOS requires TestFlight or sideloading.
projects.requirements_zh: 完整游戏需要 Heroes III Complete 或 Shadow of Death 数据，仅有 HD Edition 不够；iOS 需通过 TestFlight 或侧载安装。

projects.summary_en: A faithful Caesar III engine reimplementation for modern computers and other platforms.
projects.summary_zh: 忠实延续 Caesar III 的引擎重实现，适用于现代电脑及其他平台。
projects.requirements_en: Supply a full Caesar III installation patched to 1.0.1.0 and allow saves to be written to its data folder.
projects.requirements_zh: 需要完整的 Caesar III 安装文件并更新至 1.0.1.0，同时允许向数据目录写入存档。

projects.summary_en: A Theme Hospital engine recreation with modern resolutions and desktop support.
projects.summary_zh: 为 Theme Hospital 带来现代分辨率和桌面系统支持的引擎重实现。
projects.requirements_en: Select your own Theme Hospital data folder; the official demo offers only one level and omits most management screens.
projects.requirements_zh: 选择自有 Theme Hospital 数据目录；官方试玩版只有一个关卡，且缺少大部分管理界面。

projects.summary_en: The community-maintained 3D strategy game with a campaign, customizable units and desktop multiplayer.
projects.summary_zh: 由社区持续维护的三维战略游戏，包含战役、自定义单位和桌面多人玩法。
projects.requirements_en: Official packages need no purchased original game; the browser edition has reduced graphics and no online multiplayer.
projects.requirements_zh: 官方安装包无需另购原版游戏；浏览器版画面有所精简，不支持在线多人。

projects.summary_en: Replacement engines that run supported classic adventures on modern devices.
projects.summary_zh: 通过替代引擎，在现代设备上运行受支持的经典冒险游戏。
projects.requirements_en: Provide supported game data or choose a complete title from the official Freeware Games page; check compatibility for your device’s ScummVM version.
projects.requirements_zh: 自备受支持的游戏数据，或从官方 Freeware Games 页面选择完整免费游戏；兼容性需对应设备上的 ScummVM 版本检查。

projects.summary_en: A Duke Nukem II engine with widescreen, smoother movement, quick saves and controller support.
projects.summary_zh: 为 Duke Nukem II 提供宽屏、更平滑的移动、快速存档和手柄支持的引擎。
projects.requirements_en: Supply NUKEM2.CMP from the full game or limited shareware; the official Mac DMG is x64, with Apple silicon builds linked separately.
projects.requirements_zh: 需要完整版或有限共享版中的 NUKEM2.CMP；官方 Mac DMG 为 x64，Apple silicon 构建另有链接。

projects.summary_en: A modern reimplementation of Chris Sawyer’s Locomotion transport simulation.
projects.summary_zh: 重新实现 Chris Sawyer’s Locomotion 运输经营游戏，使其适应现代电脑。
projects.requirements_en: Supply original Locomotion data; the v26.09 Mac app requires Apple silicon and is unsigned and unnotarized.
projects.requirements_zh: 需要自备 Locomotion 原版数据；v26.09 的 Mac 版要求 Apple silicon，尚未签名和公证。

projects.summary_en: Dark Forces with widescreen, modern mouse controls, quick saves and original community mods.
projects.summary_zh: 为 Dark Forces 加入宽屏、现代鼠标操作和快速存档，并支持原版社区模组。
projects.requirements_en: Supply purchased Dark Forces data and OpenGL 3.3; Windows has an official ZIP, Linux uses Flathub, and macOS requires a source build.
projects.requirements_zh: 需要已购 Dark Forces 的数据及 OpenGL 3.3；Windows 有官方 ZIP，Linux 可用 Flathub，macOS 需源码构建。

projects.summary_en: An engine replacement for the original Jazz Jackrabbit on modern desktops.
projects.summary_zh: 让初代 Jazz Jackrabbit 在现代桌面系统上运行的替代引擎。
projects.requirements_en: Supply full-game or limited shareware data; the Linux x64 release needs glibc 2.35, while Mac Source Ports provides a signed Universal 2 Mac app.
projects.requirements_zh: 需要完整版或有限共享版数据；Linux x64 发行版要求 glibc 2.35，Mac Source Ports 另提供已签名的 Universal 2 Mac 应用。

projects.summary_en: A native desktop recompilation of Majora’s Mask with modern controls and graphics options.
projects.summary_zh: 将 Majora’s Mask 重编译为原生桌面版本，并提供现代操作与图形选项。
projects.requirements_en: Provide your own North American Nintendo 64 Majora’s Mask ROM and a compatible graphics API; Windows, Linux and macOS packages are available.
projects.requirements_zh: 需要自有的北美 Nintendo 64 版 Majora’s Mask ROM 和兼容的图形 API；已有 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 安装包。

projects.summary_en: A community project running the Switch version of Diablo II: Resurrected on compatible Apple devices.
projects.summary_zh: 让 Switch 版 Diablo II: Resurrected 在兼容 Apple 设备上运行的社区项目。
projects.requirements_en: Requires your own Switch base game plus Reign of the Warlock at 1.0.34.0 (tool version 3.3.94012), extracted ExeFS/RomFS, an A14/M1+ device, local building and signing. Older devices need converted textures; select the build for your OS and keep game-derived packages private.
projects.requirements_zh: 需要自有 Switch 本体及 Reign of the Warlock 扩展，版本为 1.0.34.0（工具中为 3.3.94012），并备好导出的 ExeFS/RomFS、A14/M1 及以上设备，完成本地构建与签名。旧设备需转换贴图，构建版本须对应系统，包含游戏衍生内容的包不能再分发。

projects.summary_en: A local-build compatibility project for turning supported Switch games into iPhone and iPad apps.
projects.summary_zh: 通过本地构建，将受支持的 Switch 游戏制作成 iPhone 和 iPad App 的兼容项目。
projects.requirements_en: Requires iOS/iPadOS 26+, an A17 Pro+ iPhone or M1+ iPad, your own game NSP/updates/DLC and prod.keys, plus a Mac with Xcode and Homebrew for building, signing and sideloading. Generated game packages are not for redistribution; compatibility is specific to each game and build.
projects.requirements_zh: 需要 iOS/iPadOS 26+、A17 Pro 及以后 iPhone 或 M1 及以后 iPad、自有游戏 NSP／更新／DLC 和 prod.keys，并在装有 Xcode、Homebrew 的 Mac 上构建后签名侧载。生成的游戏包不能再分发，兼容性须逐个游戏和构建版本确认。

projects.summary_en: A Windows and Linux recompilation of the Xbox 360 version of Modern Warfare 2 (2009).
projects.summary_zh: 将 Xbox 360 版 Modern Warfare 2（2009）重编译为 Windows 和 Linux 版本。
projects.requirements_en: Provide a USA/Europe Xbox 360 disc ISO, version 1.0.557, plus 64-bit Windows/Linux, Vulkan 1.2, 8 GB space and a controller. Public matchmaking is unsupported; the original network code has known security bugs, so online play is limited to trusted friends.
projects.requirements_zh: 需要美版或欧版 Xbox 360 光盘 ISO（1.0.557）、64 位 Windows／Linux、Vulkan 1.2、8 GB 空间和手柄。不支持公共匹配；原版网络代码存在已知安全漏洞，联机仅限可信好友。

projects.summary_en: A native Mega Man X4 recompilation with experimental local and online X/Zero co-op.
projects.summary_zh: 将 Mega Man X4 重编译为原生版本，并尝试加入 X／Zero 本地及在线合作。
projects.requirements_en: Supply USA SLUS-00561 .cue/.bin disc files; co-op is alpha, needs OpenGL and matching releases, and Linux x86_64 needs glibc 2.38+.
projects.requirements_zh: 需要美版 SLUS-00561 的 .cue／.bin 光盘文件；合作玩法为 alpha，需 OpenGL 及相同发行版，Linux x86_64 还需 glibc 2.38+。

projects.summary_en: A Pilotwings 64 port with widescreen, gamepads and configurable controls.
projects.summary_zh: 为 Pilotwings 64 加入宽屏、手柄和可配置操作的移植项目。
projects.requirements_en: Supply your own USA ROM and internet for the initial setup; desktop launchers are available, Android is experimental, and iPhone/iPad require self-building.
projects.requirements_zh: 需要自有美版 ROM，并在首次准备时联网；桌面版提供启动器，Android 属实验支持，iPhone／iPad 需自行构建。

projects.summary_en: A developer-preview iPad port of the Stratagus/Wargus Warcraft II engine with touch controls.
projects.summary_zh: 将 Stratagus／Wargus 的 Warcraft II 引擎带到 iPad 并加入触控操作，目前为开发预览。
projects.requirements_en: Requires iPadOS 16+, self-signing the unsigned IPA, and using Wargus on a Mac/PC to extract your own Warcraft II data into the complete data.Wargus folder. Copy that folder into the app manually; there is no App Store or TestFlight release.
projects.requirements_zh: 需要 iPadOS 16+，自行签名未签名 IPA，并在 Mac／PC 上用 Wargus 将自有 Warcraft II 数据提取为完整的 data.Wargus 文件夹。之后手动复制到应用中，目前没有 App Store 或 TestFlight 版本。

projects.summary_en: Diablo and Hellfire on modern devices with widescreen, controllers and optional quality-of-life changes.
projects.summary_zh: 让 Diablo 和 Hellfire 在现代设备上运行，并提供宽屏、手柄和可选的便利性改进。
projects.requirements_en: Full Diablo needs your DIABDAT.MPQ, with additional MPQs for Hellfire; limited shareware is available, and iOS requires sideloading.
projects.requirements_zh: 完整 Diablo 需要自有 DIABDAT.MPQ，Hellfire 还需额外 MPQ 文件；可使用有限共享版，iOS 需要侧载。
